newsitem.title: RUSSIA: EBRD syndicate extends $300 mln to Russian Gazprom.
newsitem.headline: EBRD syndicate extends $300 mln to Russian Gazprom.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and a bank syndicate have agreed a $300 million credit to Russian natural gas group Gazprom BRD's Moscow representative said on Monday.
"Since it was syndicated, there was an addition of $75 million to the original $225 million because of a tremendous appetite among the banks," Lou Naumovski told Reuters.
The EBRD said the credit was signed earlier this month.
The financing, the EBRD's largest syndicated loan in Russia, will fund projects to improve the safety and efficiency of Gazprom's gas pipeline system.

Banks participating in the syndidate include: Creditanstalt, ABN Amro, Bank of America, BFCE, CIBC, Citibank, Credit Lyonnais, Den Norske Bank, DKB, JP Morgan, NatWest, SBC Warburg, Societe Generale, Vereinsbank, Chase Manhattan, Dresdner Bank, IBJ and Sumitomo.
A Gazprom representative was quoted by Prime-Tass news agency on Monday as saying tenders for equipment for six projects would be held in June and results would be announced later this year.
